Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/3] Global Life Satisfaction in the Swedish sample was measured by three items dealing with the women's global life satisfaction: How satisfied are you with your life? Think about your situation during the last half year. Have the positive or the negative things outweighed? How do you like your present life? An index was formed based on the mean score of these three items. [/page/5/Text/4] Global Life Satisfaction in the Lithuanian sample was measured by SWLS (Diener et al. 1985). [/page/5/Text/5] Positive Affect and Negative Affect in all three samples were measured by the Positive Affect and Negative Affect Schedule (PANAS; Watson et al. 1988).
